content: TIL about https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9116. Probably a lot of Dataverse instances out there should add a .well-known/security.txt file. Maybe we should even encourage setting it up in the guides.
Here's a handy tool to generate the file: https://securitytxt.org/
Sure, sounds fine. No objections to a pull request to add it to the guides! You could even add it to #12549 if you like!
